# Google Patents

> A comprehensive patent search and reference platform providing access to patent records, families, and publications from multiple jurisdictions including the USPTO, Austria, and other international patent offices.

Google Patents enables researchers, inventors, and legal professionals to search, analyze, and cross-reference patent documents across global patent systems. The platform integrates data from various patent offices including the Austrian Patent Office and connects to related services like Espacenet for comprehensive patent intelligence.
